mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, uc.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, u.NICKNAME AS nickname, u.NAME AS name, u.EMAIL AS email, uc.PASSWORD_SET_YN AS passwordSetYn FROM USERS u JOIN USER_CREDENTIAL uc ON uc.USER_ID = u.USER_ID JOIN USER_ROLES ur ON ur.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId} AND u.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND ur.ROLE = 'ROLE_USER'
